answers.question: How many cards are in a tarot deck?
answers.body: A standard modern tarot deck has 78 cards:22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana. The Minor Arcana has four suits of 14 cards each, counting Ace through 10 plus Page, Knight, Queen and King. Some decks add bonus cards or rename the courts. Check the booklet before treating an extra card as a mistake.

answers.question: Does the Lovers always mean romance?
answers.body: The Lovers can be read through partnership, shared values and choice. Romance is one context, but a work agreement or a personal commitment can raise the same question: does the choice fit what matters to you? A card cannot verify what someone feels. Use their words and actions for that.

answers.question: What should I do when I keep seeing333?
answers.body: You do not have to do anything. Some numerology traditions associate 333 with creativity and expression, so you might use it as a reminder to write an idea down or say something clearly. That is a personal reflection, not evidence that a specific event will happen.
